blocks.text: The Civil Service Commission may strike from the eligible list the names of all applicants after they have remained thereon for more than one year and have failed to be appointed. (Ord. 20206 § 28, 9-10-19. Code 1981 § 31-226. Code 1995 § 106-49. Formerly 2.125.110.)
